messages.snippet: Sarah, James, Hartington IP's final IP due diligence report on CAL-218 is in the data room. Headline
messages.subject: Hartington IP — CAL-218 due diligence report
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Hartington IP's final IP due diligence report on CAL-218 is in the data room. Headline: core composition position is defensible; the EPO observation on the A family doesn't undermine the independent claims; FTO is moderate (Amgen and Boehringer families to watch). I'm comfortable proceeding.

Stephen Okoro
CSO, Hartwell Pharma
